prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-fidelity desktop web UI composition for the Spectro Console Schemas page, landscape 1440x1024. Image 1 is a reference for the established application's shell, palette, native typography, component geometry and spacing ONLY; do not copy its Live page content, observation controls, project selectors, event list, or telemetry. Keep the 184px left application sidebar and 64px top rail with the real Spectro mark and wordmark from reference, navigation Events, Issues, Performance, Network, Releases, Live, Schemas with Schemas active, Settings and API Guide at bottom. Top breadcrumb "Protocol > Schemas" and theme button. Existing palette #f5f5f7 ground, #ffffff surface, #24252b ink, #61616c muted, #5850df selection, #e2e2e7 hairlines. San Francisco/native system sans-serif UI text, SFMono machine data. Rounded 12px panels, 7px controls, thin rules, no decorative illustrations or gradients. Main content begins x238 y92 with "Schemas" at 28px and subtitle "Supported event contracts". Small neutral text "Event v1 · Envelope v1". This is GLOBAL READ-ONLY REFERENCE, not project analytics: no counts, metrics cards, refresh, time range, project selectors, forms or schema editing. Contract choices are Envelope, Event, Context, Session, Page, Error, Performance, Network, Interaction, Custom. Selected contract Error. Heading "Error payload", description "Required fields and optional error context." Supporting note "Reference for this Console build; ingestion versions may differ." Exact payload field facts: mechanism string required enum runtime / promise / resource / manual; message string required 1–2048 characters; handled boolean required; name string optional max256; stack array optional max50 frames expandable; fingerprint array optional max10 strings; source object optional expandable. Synthetic valid example JSON: {"mechanism":"runtime","message":"Example error","handled":false,"name":"TypeError","source":{"url":"https://app.example.com/checkout","line":42,"column":7}}. Label it "Synthetic example". "JSON Schema" is a separate read-only view. "Copy" button beside code. Small runtime note "64 KiB per event · 1 MiB per envelope", visually subordinate. Text crisp and legible, all regions use the same identity; no browser chrome, perspective, photograph, watermark, or invented claims.
Structure-led composition: Below the page heading, a connected three-area protocol workbench: inner contract index about 156px on left grouping Common contracts and Payloads with Error active; middle about 48% remaining width shows Error payload title, brief description and hierarchical Field / Type / Presence structure with constraints under field names, expandable stack and source nodes; right about 52% remaining width shows Example active / JSON Schema tabs, Synthetic example label, Copy button and readable multiline JSON with line numbers. The field tree and example are equally legible and visibly related, thin vertical separators join them as one instrument. Put runtime limits in a compact lower strip. Native layout comfortable at desktop size, avoid unnecessary whitespace and crowded controls.
